title: Fall throw pillow covers
text: Fall throw pillow covers. These are simply beautiful.  Thick material with good quality hidden zippers.  The covers say 18"x18" but purchase the 20" pillows for them - the 18" pillows will not fill the covers nearly enough.  The 20" pillows are just about perfect - but maybe slightly too little.  The print on the covers are very beautiful - I just love the olive and blues ... not a traditional Fall pallet, but very elegant even so.  If you're on the fence, do it.  You will not be disappointed.  In my personal opinion the quality is equal to the price.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
